text: CHIEF BLOCKS UNPROPOSED OUTPUT RECUT 8a110880ff6dcc53affdb3fff2dd2e730f7ce906 on two exact findings. Object/path audit is otherwise clean: sole parent cb63bf0, base-to-successor exact 11 paths, delta exact 8 paths, diff-check clean, author gate and mutation receipts retained. FINDING 1, authority still caller-mintable: public humanAdjudication and fixtureReview accept any nonempty Vector[Byte] and immediately promote its checksum to HumanAdjudication or FixtureReview. No typed admitted evidence record, reviewer identity, provenance, or independent witness distinguishes genuine adjudication/review from arbitrary bytes. fromWire receives only caller-supplied evidenceChecksum plus a deterministically self-signed receipt and rechecks their internal equation; it never receives or validates the evidence bytes or an independently issued admission. Therefore the exact status the type claims remains unestablished. FINDING 2, executable report-identity collision: IdRules lawfully allows colon. In an exact 8a110 archive I added one court with otherwise equal valid accounts whose sole unreferenced KnownPayloadRef is (id a:b, schema c, checksum X) versus (id a, schema b:c, checksum X). payloadParts renders both as the same single colon-concatenated string. Exact command sbt -batch viewJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.view.OutputSuite: 19 existing PASS, new court alone FAILS because both values equal ReportInputIdentity(0fd864efedb8); total 19/20. Fix all composite identity fragments with unambiguous framing or separately digested typed coordinates, and add this court plus analogous load-bearing coverage for provider params key/value framing. For authority, require an actually admitted typed evidence witness and decode against it; nonempty bytes or a reproducible self-signature cannot license a human/fixture status. Do not propose 8a110. Preserve its good joins and existing four mutations in a successor, then request chief recheck before immutable proposal.
